name: Kentucky

jury_list.statute: AP Part II, Sec. 12 (Supreme Court of Kentucky): 'The contents of any records or papers used by the Administrative Office of the Courts or the clerk in connection with the selection process and not required to be made public under these Rules shall not be disclosed', except for a motion under the civil or criminal rules or by order of the Chief Justice. No statute or rule makes the KRS 30A.145(2) list public. The copies held by the Attorney General and the State Board of Elections are public agency records under KRS 61.870, but no source says whether an exemption (KRS 61.878(1)(a) privacy) covers them. Status unknown, so the strict default applies.
fields_withheld: Contents of records or papers the AOC or the clerk uses in jury selection: not disclosed except for a court-rule motion or by order of the Chief Justice (AP Part II, Sec. 12)
Juror qualification forms: available to the trial judge and the parties' attorneys of record only (AP Part II, Sec. 7(7); KRS 29A.070(7))
jury_list.official_pipeline: KRS 30A.145(2): on the first Tuesday of each month the AOC lists all persons excused from jury duty for not being U.S. citizens and sends the list to the Attorney General, the U.S. Attorney, and the State Board of Elections. KRS 116.113(3): the State Board removes the name within 5 days, except while registration books are closed. KRS 116.113(6): the county clerk updates files within 10 days; the voter may protest to the county board afterward.

sources.cite: KRS 30A.145 (monthly AOC list of jury non-citizen excusals)
KRS 116.113 (State Board removes name within 5 days)
Supreme Court of Kentucky Order 2020-73, AP Part II (Jury Selection and Management), Sec. 7(7), 8(2)(b) and 12
KRS 29A.080(2)(b) (a person who 'Is not a citizen of the United States' is disqualified)
KRS 61.878(1)(a), (l) (Open Records Act exemptions: personal privacy; confidential by enactment of the General Assembly)

voter_file.who_may_get: Qualified candidates, political party committees or officials, and committees for or against a ballot question; other persons at the State Board's discretion (KRS 117.025(3)(i)).
voter_file.permitted_uses: Not for commercial use (KRS 117.025(3)(i)). The SBE 84 oath limits use to a campaign, a party committee, a ballot-question committee, or another purpose the State Board allows.
voter_file.attestation_required: SBE 84 request, signed 'UNDER OATH': requester category, no commercial use, no sale or gift to commercial users. 'Other' requesters must explain how the purpose fits KRS 117.025(3)(i) and 31 KAR 3:010; the State Board decides.

sources.cite: SBE 84 Request for Voter Registration Data (State Board form)

private_challenge.who: At the polls: a challenger may dispute a voter's right to vote; the voter signs an oath, which goes to the Commonwealth's attorney (KRS 117.245). No pre-election written challenge by a private voter was found.

state_election_office.note: Already receives the AOC jury non-citizen list monthly (KRS 30A.145(2)).

ag.name: Kentucky Attorney General
ag.note: Also receives the AOC list monthly (KRS 30A.145(2)).

audit_path.statute: KRS 61.872 (Kentucky Open Records Act; Kentucky residents) and 52 U.S.C. 20507(i) (NVRA public inspection of list-maintenance records)
audit_path.what_you_can_request: Counts only: per month, the number of persons on the AOC's KRS 30A.145(2) list received by the State Board of Elections; the number removed under KRS 116.113(3); the number held because registration books were closed; and the number of protests and restorations under 116.113(6). Also read the public annual report under KRS 116.114(1)(c) (number of 'citizenship status changes').
audit_path.note: Do not ask for names. Jury selection records are confidential (AP Part II, Sec. 12). The Open Records Act right belongs to Kentucky residents (KRS 61.872(1)).

gates.basis: The jury non-citizen list goes to the AG, U.S. Attorney and State Board (KRS 30A.145(2)); no statute makes it public (null). A private person may not get the voter list as of right (KRS 117.025(3)(i)). Strict gates: counts only.

notes: CHANGED 2026-10-07: applied under Optimus standing rule (no gate loosens). Added AP Part II Sec. 12 and fields_withheld; 116.113(6) protest; SBE 84 oath; juryroll_lead_sufficient false; audit_path; HB 139 (2026) note; federal_source_url moved to govinfo. jury_list.public stays null: AP Part II binds the AOC and clerks only; the status of the AG and State Board copies is unknown.
Duplication: Kentucky already runs the exact match JuryRoll does, monthly, with removal in 5 days (KRS 116.113(3)). An aggregate referral should ask about that process.
dob_in_public_file and registration_date_in_public_file are null: not confirmed.
Removal under KRS 116.113(3) has no notice before removal. The voter may protest after removal; the county board hears it at its next monthly meeting (116.113(6)(b)).

HB 139 (2026 Ky. Acts ch. 175, veto overridden Apr. 14, 2026): amends 116.113 (no change to the jury ground) and 116.114 (public annual report with citizenship status change counts). A new KRS Chapter 116 section (Sec. 30, effective Jan. 1, 2028) lets the State Board match voters with federal agencies, mark matches, and require proof of citizenship before voting.
